<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/complaint-process">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Refund"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle customer complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FeedbackReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FeedbackRecorded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FinancialTeam" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessReimbursement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDetails" name="Review complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineDecision" name="Determine complaint validity and refund eligibility"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${refundApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundMerge" name="Continue after refund decision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint resolved"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" name="Customer provides feedback?" default="Flow_NoFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FeedbackReceived" name="Feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordFeedback" name="Record customer feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackRecorded" name="Feedback recorded"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoFeedback" name="Case resolved without feedback"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplaintToLog" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogToAssign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignToReview" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToDetermine" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_DetermineDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineToNotify" sourceRef="Task_DetermineDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToDecision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReimbursementToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToResolved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolvedToFeedbackChoice" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackProvided" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="Event_FeedbackReceived">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${feedbackProvided}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackChoice" targetRef="End_NoFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToRecord" sourceRef="Event_FeedbackReceived" targetRef="Task_RecordFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToEnd" sourceRef="Task_RecordFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackRecorded"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Files complaint" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Complaint decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Reimbursement" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provides feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_FeedbackReceived" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
